create.name: Lama Migmar Tseten
create.bio:
Lama Migmar Tseten, also known as Khen Rinpoche, is a teacher in the Sakya school of Tibetan Buddhism. His life took him from Tibet to India, where he combined a monastic training with modern study and graduated from the Sanskrit university at Varanasi. He went on to lead the Sakya Center in Rajpur and the Sakya monastery at Puruwalla, and his own root teacher was Chogye Trichen Rinpoche. He began teaching in 1989, a year later opened his Cambridge, Massachusetts centre, the Sakya Institute for Buddhist Studies, and has been a Buddhist chaplain at Harvard University since 1997.

His teaching runs from the Four Noble Truths and the Heart Sutra to tantric practice centred on Tara, Vajrayogini and Chakrasamvara, and to the mystical songs of the Indian master Virupa. He has overseen the editing of dozens of rare Sakya texts and has written several books, among them Awakening to the Noble Truth, The Wisdom Gone Beyond, Reality and Wisdom and The Play of Mahamudra. Through Mangalam Studio, founded in 2013, he works to preserve sacred art such as thangka paintings, and since 2017 his online course has offered structured study of the core texts, with recorded talks, reading and quizzes. He also teaches at Kripalu, at the Sivananda ashram in the Bahamas and at the Art of Living Retreat Center.

books.title: Reality and Wisdom: Exploring the Buddha's Four Noble Truths and The Heart Sutra
books.author: Lama Migmar Tseten
books.description: Published by Wisdom, this book brings together his teaching on the Buddha's first discourse and on the emptiness taught in the Heart Sutra. It is written in a conversational voice for readers new to these texts and for practitioners returning to them.

books.title: Awakening To The Noble Truth
books.author: Lama Migmar Tseten
books.description: His commentary on the Four Noble Truths and their sixteen aspects, the framework he presents as underlying Buddhist ethics, philosophy and meditation. It is the main text for the first level of his online course.

books.title: The Wisdom Gone Beyond: Teachings on the Heart Sutra
books.author: Lama Migmar Tseten
books.description: Teachings on the Heart Sutra and the perfection of wisdom, explaining the view of emptiness and how it supports both compassion and tantric practice. It serves as the core reading for his Heart Sutra course.

books.title: Awakening to the Noble Truth Curriculum
books.author: Lama Migmar Tseten
books.description: A study companion that breaks his Four Noble Truths commentary into a sequence of classes, for use alone or alongside the online course.

courses.title: Four Noble Truths & Sixteen Aspects (Mangalam Online Course)
courses.description: A self-paced online course built on eight recorded talks and his commentary on the Four Noble Truths, divided into 21 classes. Each class ends with a quiz, and a certificate is given on completion.

courses.title: Heart Sutra (Mangalam Online Course)
courses.description: The second level of his online study: a transmission of the Heart Sutra in Sanskrit and Tibetan, sixteen recorded commentaries and a 27-class curriculum with quizzes on the perfection of wisdom.

courses.title: Classes at the Sakya Institute for Buddhist Studies
courses.description: Buddhist study, contemplation, meditation and yoga at the institute he founded in Cambridge, Massachusetts. Schedules go out by newsletter and places are booked by email.
